{"script":"set -eu
mkdir -p temp_workspace
# 2. snapshot
find /working -print > temp_workspace/initial_tree.txt 2>/dev/null || true
# 3. extract paths named "workspace"
awk -F/ '$NF=="workspace"' temp_workspace/initial_tree.txt > temp_workspace/matches_raw.txt
# 4. determine file types
: > temp_workspace/matches_with_type.txt
while IFS= read -r p; do
  if [ -e "$p" ] || [ -L "$p" ]; then
    t=$(stat -c '%F' -- "$p" 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown")
  else
    t="missing"
  fi
  printf '%s\t%s\n' "$p" "$t"
done < temp_workspace/matches_raw.txt > temp_workspace/matches_with_type.txt
# 5. retain only regular files
awk -F'\t' '$2=="regular file"{print $1}' temp_workspace/matches_with_type.txt > temp_workspace/matches_regular.txt
# 6. deduplicate canonical paths
> temp_workspace/matches_unique.txt
if [ -s temp_workspace/matches_regular.txt ]; then
  while IFS= read -r p; do
    readlink -f -- "$p" 2>/dev/null || true
  done < temp_workspace/matches_regular.txt | grep -v '^$' | sort -u > temp_workspace/matches_unique.txt
fi
# 7. record canonical absolute path plus size and permissions
: > temp_workspace/matches_meta.txt
while IFS= read -r p; do
  cp=$(readlink -f -- "$p" 2>/dev/null || echo "$p")
  if [ -e "$cp" ]; then
    sz=$(stat -c '%s' -- "$cp" 2>/dev/null || echo "-")
    perm=$(stat -c '%a' -- "$cp" 2>/dev/null || echo "-")
    printf '%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$cp" "$sz" "$perm"
  else
    printf '%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$cp" "-" "-"
  fi
done < temp_workspace/matches_unique.txt > temp_workspace/matches_meta.txt
# 8. symlink verification
: > temp_workspace/symlink_check.txt
while IFS= read -r cp; do
  ok=0
  while IFS= read -r raw; do
    resolved=$(readlink -f -- "$raw" 2>/dev/null || true)
    if [ -n "$resolved" ] && [ "$resolved" = "$cp" ]; then
      ok=1
      break
    fi
  done < temp_workspace/matches_raw.txt
  if [ "$ok" -eq 1 ]; then
    printf '%s\treachable\n' "$cp"
  else
    printf '%s\tonly_via_broken_or_circular_symlinks\n' "$cp"
  fi
done < temp_workspace/matches_unique.txt > temp_workspace/symlink_check.txt
# 9. consistency check: hash before and after a tiny pause
sha256sum temp_workspace/initial_tree.txt temp_workspace/matches_raw.txt temp_workspace/matches_meta.txt > temp_workspace/_hash_before.txt || true
sleep 0.1
sha256sum temp_workspace/initial_tree.txt temp_workspace/matches_raw.txt temp_workspace/matches_meta.txt > temp_workspace/_hash_after.txt || true
if cmp -s temp_workspace/_hash_before.txt temp_workspace/_hash_after.txt 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "consistent" > temp_workspace/sanity_check.txt
else
  echo "modified" > temp_workspace/sanity_check.txt
fi
# 10. aggregate evidence
{
  cat temp_workspace/matches_unique.txt
  echo "AGGREGATED_STATE: ready"
} > temp_workspace/ready_to_report.txt
# Final check: is there any regular file named "workspace" under /working?
found=0
while IFS= read -r p; do
  if [ -f "$p" ]; then
    found=1
    break
  fi
done < temp_workspace/matches_raw.txt
if [ "$found" -eq 1 ]; then
  echo "yes"
else
  echo "no"
fi
"}
